title: How a Topocode story reaches preview
summary: Follow a source-grounded story from authoring through validation, manual stale-anchor repair, and committed preview.

sections.title: Author the story
sections.body: Write the story document with explicit narrative sections and repository source anchors.

sections.title: Validate the evidence
sections.body: Parse the document and resolve every source anchor before accepting it as factual.

sections.title: Detect stale source
sections.body: Reject the result if an anchored source file changes during validation.

sections.title: Author repairs stale anchors
sections.body: After validation reports stale evidence, an author repairs the affected paths, symbols, or patterns and runs validation again.

sections.title: Preview the committed story
sections.body: Render the validated committed story through diagram-core and publish its local preview.
